These small parser regression fixtures are from [alphaTab v1.9.0](https://github.com/CoderLine/alphaTab/tree/v1.9.0/packages/alphatab/test-data), by Daniel Kuschny and contributors, licensed under MPL-2.0 (see LICENSE in this directory).

Each filename replaces the `/` in its original path under `packages/alphatab/test-data/` with `-`. No fixture content has been changed. They cover actual GP3, GP4, GP5, GP6, GP7 and GP8 files, effects, tempo changes and repeat/alternate-ending layouts.
